data.title: The Rings
data.about:
Discover The Rings Dubai Water Canal, an extraordinary waterfront development by PMR Property. Nestled gracefully along the serene Dubai Water Canal, The Rings by PMR presents opulent living in two distinct structures.

Within each mansion, lavish residences ranging from 9,500 sq. ft., to 19,800 sq. ft., await. Available as 5 and 6-bedroom duplexes and 6 to 7-bedroom triplexes, these homes redefine luxury living with private swimming pools, elevators, gyms, cinemas, extensive garden terraces, and floor-to-ceiling windows. Residents enjoy sweeping 180-degree views of both the Dubai Water Canal and the iconic Burj Khalifa.

Upon entering The Rings, a grand double-height lobby surrounded by tranquil reflective pools sets the stage for a truly immersive experience. Convenience reaches new heights with personalized underground parking pods, complete with a private car showroom and lifts that seamlessly connect to the residential units.

Welcome to The Rings at Jumeirah, where sophistication, sustainability, and an elevated lifestyle converge along the enchanting Dubai Water Canal.

characteristics_module.title: Reside in stunning Sky Mansions at The Rings.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Ultra-Boutique Concept: Only 12 residences across two independent buildings ensure ultimate exclusivity and privacy.
  • Waterfront Serenity: Direct access to the Dubai Water Canal promenade offers tranquil, resort-style living in the city center.
  • Fully Independent Villas-in-the-Sky: Each unit feels like a standalone mansion with its own entrance, amenities, and vertical circulation.
  • Private Sky Amenities: Personal cinemas, gyms, and lush gardens within each residence redefine in-home luxury.
  • Architecturally Curated Views: Every layout is oriented to capture uninterrupted views of iconic Dubai landmarks and waterfront.
  • Discreet Luxury Living: Designed for UHNWIs, the project prioritizes seclusion, security, and tailored services over mass appeal.
  • Landmark Neighbors: Adjacent to elite addresses like Four Seasons Residences and Mr. C Residences, boosting prestige and long-term value.
  • Bespoke Interiors by Global Icons: Curated interiors with finishes from Italy’s finest design houses offer a one-of-a-kind aesthetic identity.

location_tile.title: Experience convenient accessibility to The Rings at Jumeirah.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the heart of Business Bay, Dubai and situated next to Al Wasl Road, The Rings Dubai Water Canal Location presents a vibrant mix of commercial and residential offering. This area boasts luxurious hotel towers, top-tier restaurants, and stylish residential spaces. Renowned for its chic ambiance and affinity for the newest trends and technologies, the community thrives at a brisk pace. Situated to the south of Downtown Dubai, Business Bay is a hub of cultural and social activities. From music festivals and Mother’s Day festivities to grand New Year’s celebrations, it’s a locale that pulsates with energy. Living in Business Bay, with its myriad of benefits, exemplifies a dynamic and modern lifestyle.

  • Walking distance to Jumeirah Beach
  • 5 minutes to DIFC
  • 7 minutes to Burj Al Arab
  • 12 minutes to Dubai International Airport

more_info.answer: The Rings by PMR is an ultra-luxury residential development located along the Dubai Water Canal in Jumeirah. It comprises two low-rise buildings, each housing six exclusive residences, including 5 to 7-bedroom Sky Mansions and Sky Palaces. ​
more_info.question: What is The Rings by PMR?

more_info.answer: The project is developed by PMR Property, a luxury real estate developer known for high-end projects across Europe. The architecture is designed by Foster + Partners, a globally recognized firm renowned for innovative and sustainable designs. ​
more_info.question: Who is the developer of The Rings by PMR?

more_info.answer: The development offers 5 to 6-bedroom Sky Mansions and 6 to 7-bedroom Sky Palaces, with sizes ranging from approximately 9,500 to 19,800 square feet. ​
more_info.question: What types of residences are available in The Rings by PMR?

more_info.answer: Residents can enjoy private elevators, air-conditioned garages, swimming pools, gyms, cinemas, and garden terraces. Additional facilities include a spa, wellness center, beauty salon, yoga studio, residents' lounge, cigar lounge, and children's playgrounds. ​
